_note: Folder-owned PUBLIC MIRROR declaration (ClosedSource/scripts/mirror_public.rb; OpenSource/CanvasEditor/mirror.json documents the schema). This folder is the source of truth; the mirror repo is a generated, read-only copy and PRs happen here, never there. The public repo doubles as the TextMate grammar source GitHub Linguist vendors for DespiaScript (see ../linguist/README.md), so what ships must stay a valid standalone VS Code extension: grammar at syntaxes/dsx.tmLanguage.json, scope text.dsx, detectable Apache-2.0 LICENSE at the root. `check` must exit 0 before any push; `tag_from` cuts a v<version> tag on the mirror whenever package.json's version changes.
